text:
alex: Found a potato on the couch this morning. Not sure how it got there. Anyone missing a side dish?
maria: 😂 was it wearing a tiny scarf?
sam: Please tell me it's not one of those meme potatoes that show up in the office. Last time it stole my chair.
nora: If the potato has a name, we can add it to the onboarding checklist. 'Couch Spud' has a nice ring.
alex: no scarf, just a suspicious gravy stain. Proposing we adopt it as an office mascot until HR files a missing-sack report. :potato:
maria: Vote: adopt Couch Spud or return to wild? :white_check_mark: adopt / :x: release to wild
sam: :white_check_mark: adopt (would accept mascot duties)
nora: :white_check_mark: adopt — I'll make a tiny badge.
dev-bot: Reminder: office mascot items must not block fire exits. (automated safety ping)
alex: Noted, dev-bot. Couch Spud will have a safety brief at 2pm. Agenda: nap schedule and snack priorities.
maria: Also adding 'how to pet the potato' to the wiki under /fun-stuff. Someone gif it pls.
sam: Uploaded: <link_to_gif> (potato slowly nodding). Caption: "When the sprint ends but you're still on standby."
nora: Ok I'm framing this. Hanging it on the snack wall beside the cookie jar. 
maria: Can we get a tiny cape? For morale.
alex: Done. Tiny cape procurement in flight. Updates as the cape saga continues. :cape:
sam: Love it. Office morale +5. Also: who brought extra socks in case of potato theft emergencies?
nora: I have two. One for me, one for Couch Spud.
alex: Thread conclusion: Couch Spud adopted, cape incoming, safety checked by dev-bot. Meeting adjourned. :party_parrot:
